limitations: All inputs are original synthetic OCR regions; no patient data was used.
Capture and quality fields are labels, not measurements from physical scans or cameras.
The report does not measure OCR recognition, handwriting, lab tables, latency, clinical outcomes, or material-error escape rate.
A perfect score on seven fixtures is parser regression evidence only and is not a release claim.
Clinical-safety, privacy/security, accessibility, facility-operations, and engineering approvals remain pending.
